high_level_description: This image captures a serene and expansive view of a multi-lane highway stretching into the distance under a vast sky. The road is wide and appears to be in good condition, with clear lane markings and a central divider. On the left side of the road, there is a grassy area bordered by a metal guardrail, while on the right side, there is a yellow and black striped barrier, likely for safety. The sky above is dynamic, filled with large, fluffy clouds that vary in density and color, ranging from white to grayish-blue.
